decisions.reason: After one year on the market, this core-adjacent API still looks like a low-cost option on the firm’s existing cloud communications platform, so a large German provider would usually keep it unless clear commercial weakness had emerged.

As a newly introduced gateway tightly connected to the firm’s established messaging and integration business, it is cheap to maintain relative to its upside, so real-options logic favors keeping it while customer adoption becomes clearer.

This product is also a close extension of the firm’s secure communication stack, and given low expected continuation costs, strategic fit, and ongoing industry growth, management would likely keep the option open rather than withdraw it quickly.
